excerpts: Momentus Enterprise is the full-depth platform for large and complex operations: convention centers, exhibition halls, stadiums, large performing arts centers, and multi-venue operators. Momentus Elite is the streamlined modern platform for small and mid-sized venues: performing arts centers, museums, small and mid-sized convention centers, arenas, and municipal operators.
